rows.en: You can't hold a candle to me, the great Walter Gundam, empowered by the DG Cells!!
Kiiiiiih!! Kiiiiiih!!
I'll shut both those mouths of yours!
Diiie!!
Kiiiiiih!! Kiiiiiih!!
Hyaaahhahahahahahaha!! Time to finish you ooooff!!
Fuhahahahaha...!! Too easy!!
Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
So that's... Walter Gundam...!!
You heroes...!! So in the semifinals, I'm up against you lot!
You saw it, didn't you? My fight! Don't you go losing your nerve and running away, now!
You lot are destined to be thoroughly beaten to a pulp by me!!
Hyahahahahahaha...!!
So this is where you were. I've been looking for you.
Huh? What do you want?
The semifinal venue is ready. Proceed to the venue on Floor 3.
They're at it.
Haah... Haah... What a hard-shelled bastard!!
Fufufufufu!! I can defeat the likes of you any time I please.
What did you say!?
Come now, fire away at me!
...So your plan is to wear me down like this!!
...Please don't say things that spoil the mood.
Hit the nail on the head, didn't I!!
...Well now, who can say?
What kind of match is this...
There's no point watching this. Let's go.
So this is where you were. I've been looking for you.
Huh? What do you want?
The semifinal venue is ready. Proceed to the venue on Floor 3.
This isn't the Hero Team's match venue. Yours is the room on the opposite side.
This is the venue for the semifinal match.

The matchup is:
Hero Team VS Walter Gundam
The match begins shortly. Are you ready?
There's no time to spare. Once you're prepared, come straight back.
Very well. Then go in.
So you came, did you? You heroes!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
Sorry to keep you waiting.
We've kept you waiting.
We've kept you waiting.
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
Sorry to keep ya waitin'! You weirdo-lookin' Gundam!!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
We've kept you waiting, Walter Gundam...!!
I'll beat you lot and make my name ring out across the world!
Let me tell you up front: I never had any interest in being king of this Cube!
Soon, the Devil Gundam will be revived! I shall become its Life Core,
and reign as king of the entire universe!!
Hyahahahahahaha!!!
You bastard!! Vile scum like you... I can't let you live!!
Something like you could never be a Gundam!!
You have no right to call yourself a Gundam!!
A Gundam like that!? I'll correct you!!
What are you even talking about?
I'll smash that ambition of yours!!
An ambition like that... I won't allow it!!
Silence!! I cannot let you get away with this!!
Silence!! I cannot let you get away with this!!
I can't allow an ambition like that!!
We'll smash that ambition of yours!!

notes.note: Walter Gundam continues from story_083 #0.9 (mocking Pandon). Self-honorific '-sama' = 'the great Walter Gundam'. Glossary g=n, so no he/she for Walter Gundam.
Pandon is two-headed: the two-line cry is one shriek per head, matching story_083's 'Kiiiiiih!! Kiiiiiih!!'; hence 'both those mouths' in #0.12.
0454.bla: #0.20 plays only if the leader is God Gundam (id 8); every other leader gets #0.21. #0.22-0.33 are identical copies with identical English. 'Rider 1' labels are the extractor's guess.
Contemptuous plural 'heroes' = 'You heroes'. 'Fight' in #0.37 is the Gundam Fight sense, kept as 'my fight'.
Same wording as story_025's Masquerade line. #0.41-0.43 and 0456 #0.17-0.19 are identical and share English; 'Floor 3' per venue style.
'Hard' = Alien Reflect's hard, attack-reflecting body: 'hard-shelled bastard'.
Violence Dopant claiming he guessed Reflect's stalling plan: 'Hit the nail on the head'.
Deliberate two-line card layout kept with a line break.
Unlabelled #0.3 and #0.9: Masquerade Dopant continuing (same pattern as 0449 in story_082).

Leader variants #0.11-0.24, order verified in 0458.bla (if-chain sets k=0..13): God Gundam, 00, Zeta, Wing Zero, Nu, Zero, Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, OOO, W, Den-O Sword (#0.22, rough 'weird Gundam'), RX, Rider 1. Plain 'kept you waiting' = 'We've kept you waiting' (subject 'we' restored: the team arrives); the apologetic form = 'Sorry to keep you waiting'. #0.21 lacks a comma; same English.
Devil Gundam's human host ('biological unit') rendered 'living core unit'; not in glossary. Sentence continues into #0.30, cut at the same point.

Second leader block #0.32-0.45 (ends in story_085), same order: #0.32 God Gundam, #0.33 00, #0.34 Zeta, #0.35 Wing Zero, #0.36 Nu, #0.37 Zero, #0.38 Mebius, #0.39 Ultraman, #0.40 Seven, #0.41 OOO, #0.42 W. #0.32 is cut off on its final syllable in the source; rendered as a complete exclamation.

UNCERTAIN: by script order #0.35 is Wing Zero's slot, but 'I'll correct you' is Kamille's (Zeta) famous catchphrase, so #0.34/#0.35 may be swapped in the table. Translated as written; worth an in-game check.
Nu's slot: Amuro's flat disbelief at Walter's plan.
W's slot; plural first person = Shotaro and Philip, so 'We'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader orders verified from 0454.bla/0458.bla. Uncertain: 0458 #0.35 (Kamille's 'I'll correct you' sits in Wing Zero's slot; #0.34/#0.35 may be swapped in the table). Not in glossary: 'living core unit' (Devil Gundam host). Pandon cry matches story_083.
